title: American Economic History Case Files
description: Five structured historical case files: Canals & Railroads (1790s–1880s), Banking Panics & National Banking System (1863–1913), Progressive Era (1890–1920), Great Depression (1929–1941), Postwar Boom (1945–1973). Each case includes overview, data, 4 key questions with analytic answers, primary source excerpt, and analysis framework.
data_vintage: Historical Statistics of the US (Cambridge); Gordon 2016; Friedman & Schwartz 1963
